stories.label: Still waiting · World · Due process
stories.head: Imaan Mazari-Hazir and Hadi Ali Chattha
bullets: Human rights lawyers held since 23 Jan 2026.
Anti-terrorism court sentenced both to 10 years on 29 Oct, after a trial inside Adiala prison.
Law minister says the judiciary is independent.
stories.caption: Human Rights Watch reports the Supreme Court had suspended their earlier sentences on 17 September; the couple deny the charges.

photo.alt: Faisal Mosque in Islamabad lit at dusk, with the city's lights spread out behind it.
photo.caption: Islamabad at dusk in 2014, with Faisal Mosque in front.

stories.label: Still waiting · India · Due process
stories.head: Pranab Doley
bullets: Arrested 12 Jul 2026; held under the NSA (order 30 Jul) after getting bail.
Gauhati High Court reserved its verdict on his challenge on 14 Oct.
Govt cites public order; police did not answer press questions.
stories.caption: The Wire says it sent questions to Assam Police on 28 and 29 October and received no response.

photo.alt: Tall grass in the foreground and a lone tree on flat grassland under a blue sky.
photo.caption: Grassland in Kaziranga National Park, Assam, in 2023.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Press
stories.head: Artin Ghazanfari
bullets: Sentenced to 26 years, told on 26 Oct; has heart failure.
Judge reportedly refused a hospital transfer; Iran did not reply to CPJ.
stories.caption: CPJ reports that 20 of the 26 years are for "media activities", and that he is held in Greater Tehran Prison.

photo.alt: Tehran's buildings and a highway below snow-capped mountains under clouds.
photo.caption: Tehran with the Alborz mountains behind, in 2015.

stories.label: Still waiting · India · Assembly
stories.head: Four Geku villagers
bullets: Held since 9 Oct under the state's anti-terror law amid dam protests.
After the 23 Oct Pasighat arson, police say 69 people were arrested.
The chief minister has offered talks.
stories.caption: Arunachal Times names them as Adum Tayom, Omak Paron, Okut Paloh and Oson Paron.

photo.alt: A wide, calm river between forested hills, with tall grass in the foreground.
photo.caption: The Siang river in Arunachal Pradesh. The proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project would dam this river.
